title: Steganography of Steganographic Networks
motivation: DNN-based steganographic schemes cannot be deployed because the secret decoder is too large to transmit safely in public channels
problem_framing: Disguise secret DNN model into stego DNN model for ordinary ML task, satisfying recoverability/fidelity/capacity/undetectability constraints
key_insight: Filters important for secret task but trivial for stego task can be selected via gradient importance, preserving secret functionality while reactivating remaining filters for stego task
method_signature: Progressive filter selection + partial optimization to disguise secret DNN into stego DNN performing ordinary task
evaluation_criteria: Recoverability (BER/PSNR), fidelity (ACC/mIOU), capacity (expansion rate), undetectability (detection accuracy ≈50%)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Previous DNN steganographic schemes recover models with 50% BER and 10% ACC — completely broken for DNN model hiding
evidence_for_taste: the recovered DNN models do not work at all
difficult for the attackers to identify
thinking_moves: 把steganography问题从数据层提升到网络层 — 从隐藏信息变成隐藏整个模型
先识别问题本质: secret decoder的大小和传输安全是关键瓶颈
用梯度重要性作为filter selection的度量 — 反向思考哪些参数该保留
引入partial optimization的思想 — 只更新非关键filter,避免破坏secret task
渐进式disguising代替一次性disguise — 逐步平衡secret和stego任务性能
通过对比实验承认已有方法的失败: DNN steganographic schemes are not suitable for hiding DNN models
